findings.description: The Lambda function embeds an AWS access key and secret key in plaintext environment variables. Anyone with Describe/GetFunction permissions on the resource can read these credentials, and the secrets are committed to source control, which the guidance requires treating as compromised regardless of removal.

The function uses runtime nodejs12.x, which is end-of-life and no longer receives security patches from AWS while continuing to execute. Running a deprecated runtime exposes the workload to unpatched vulnerabilities.
